events.name: Old Friend Returns

remembers.notice: In its mouth, small and wet and folded, is a paper boat. The one you floated for it, believing it gone. It is not gone. It brought it back.
It is not alone. At a respectful distance, others have stopped on the road. Pawprints you remember, one after another. They are waiting their turn.

events.intro:
*Something on the road. It was going somewhere else. It has stopped.*

*It tilts its head, the way it always did. You know that tilt. You have known it all this time.*

*It recognises you. Of course it does.*

choices.label: Kneel down, and hold out a hand.

success.text: You kneel in the dust. It crosses the road to you, slowly, as if afraid to be wrong.

events.name: Old Friend Returns: A New Trainer
events.intro:
*A girl of about twelve is hurrying up the road, a Poké Ball held tight. She stops short.*

**Minna Lindgren:** "Do you two know each other? It's never done that. It's never *stopped* for anyone."

*She looks from {oldfriend:name} to you. She is waiting to be told. Nothing. Or everything. Your choice.*

success.text: She goes quiet. "Did you... not want it?" The words are small. Then you answer her, with the reason you gave once, exactly as you gave it.

effects.text: "I thought it would be happier here." She listens. She holds its Ball a little tighter. "It is," she says. "Mostly."
"I had no room." She nods slowly. She knows what that costs. She holds the Ball out a little, and then draws it back.
"It wasn't strong enough." Her face changes. She holds its Ball a little tighter. "It is now," she says, fiercely. "Look at it."
You have no reason to give her. You say so. She listens to that, too, for a long time, and then holds the Ball out, just a little.

success.text: {oldfriend:name} looks at you. For a moment it seems about to say something, in whatever way it says things. Then it lets it go. It is kind of you, or cowardly. Nobody says which.

choices.label: It's a good Pokémon. Look after it.

success.text: **Minna:** "I do." {oldfriend:name} leans against her leg, and looks at you over its shoulder, steadily, the whole way down the road.

events.name: Old Friend Returns: Stronger Now
events.intro:
*It steps back, and squares up. It is {oldfriend:species} now, and it is not the one you let go.*

*It wants you to see. That is all. It has wanted you to see for a very long time.*

*One on one. Against the Pokémon that took its place.*

success.text: Both of you step forward. Nobody else joins in. This was always going to be just the two of them.

events.name: Old Friend Returns: It Nods
events.intro:
*Win or lose, it stops. It looks at you. Then it nods, once, slowly, the way you would nod to someone who finally understood.*

*It is done. It was always only this.*

success.text: It goes on down the road. You watch it as far as the bend. It does not look back, because it does not need to.

effects.text: An old friend came back to be seen. It was seen.

events.name: Old Friend Returns: A Good Turn
events.intro:
*It does not fight you. It sits in the road, and looks up at you, content. It is warm, and fed, and well.*

*It is going the same way you are, for a little while. It means to be there for the hard part.*

*Come the next hard fight, it will find you. It said so, in its own way.*

success.text: It looks at you for a long moment. Then it looks at the road it was on.

then.text: An old friend came back, and chose to stay.

effects.text: It steps forward. Once. Then it leans its whole weight against your leg, the way it always did. It is yours, and it chose to be.
It walks beside you a little way. Then it stops, and looks back at where it came from, and does not follow. That is its answer. You do not ask again.

success.text: You wave. It waves back, the only way it can, with its whole body. Somewhere ahead, in the next hard fight, it will be there.

events.name: Old Friend Returns: Unsaid
events.intro:
*It looks at you for a long time before it moves. There is a question in it, and it is not asking it out loud.*

*You never said why. It has had all this time to wonder.*

success.text: It nods once, as if that is an answer. Then it stands, and you both begin.
It falls in beside you without a sound. For the rest of the stage, it walks at your heel. At the Gym door, it will stop.
It looks at you for a long moment. Then it looks at the road it was on.
